If the spec already says a `decide` step in flight is re-run at resume, add `_inflight.py` (and the test file that pins the in-flight classification, if an existing test must change) to T14's files and size the budget for it, and prove it with the trial the playbook section 1 requires (apply the smallest edit in a scratch copy of the B-113 branch, run `uv run eng-gate check --package eng-harness --skip mutation` to `check: pass`, list every file touched, revert; use a scratch worktree such as <worktrees>/b481-trial, never commit in <worktrees>/b113). If the spec does not say it, change nothing for (b) and report the exact question in your summary as a lead finding. Keep to these edits. The pull request body line is `Plan-Task: none (spec and plan)`.

This task is already written: branch feat/b113-harness-et14-ctx-decide-and-ctx in <worktrees>/b113, commits 1a91cc9 (test:) and 0a883b9 (feat), 387 counted lines; read <lead>/reports/b113-writer.md first.
